rules.label: RB-RB start
rules.note: Open with two running backs where the board allows it.

rules.label: Don't end R4 at 2RB/2WR
rules.note: Two RBs and two WRs through four rounds leaves QB and TE both unfilled — spend one of the next picks on a onesie.

rules.label: QB after the top two
rules.note: Happy to take a high-tier QB, but not Josh Allen or Lamar Jackson at their price.

rules.label: No premium onesie TE
rules.note: Not paying up for a top-tier TE, but do not want to be shut out by a run either.
